outcome: prevalence of maternal insecurity in breastfeeding
factors associated with maternal insecurity in breastfeeding
cohort: Lactating women treated at the Human Milk Bank of the University Hospital of the Federal University of Maranhao between January 2017 and December 2018.
finding: Maternal insecurity in breastfeeding was significantly associated with the place where prenatal care was received, the place of delivery, and the mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Maternal insecurity in breastfeeding was significantly associated with the place of delivery and the mode of delivery.
